latestVersion.changelog:
Free Editor Generation 1.0.0 — First Release

- Instantly edit and export videos without learning complex editing tools.
- Upload raw footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) and describe your edit — e.g., "trim silences, add cuts, and export a clean final video".
- Automated 1080p MP4 export through fast cloud GPU rendering.
- No installation required; connects to a cloud API with a free anonymous token for new users.
- Supports batch uploads, iterative editing, and automatic error handling for token, session, and file issues.
